headline: Sensex, Nifty Fall for 6th Week Amid Fed Hike and Global Cues
why: US Federal Reserve interest rate hike concerns impacting global liquidity
Rising crude oil prices putting pressure on Indian fiscal deficit
Bank of Japan signaling potential for accelerated interest rate hikes
Negative sentiment following six consecutive weeks of domestic market declines
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty50 indices closed lower for the sixth straight week
Ghaziabad traders are boycotting UPI payments starting October 15 over MDR
Alibaba open-sourced its Damo Radar AI model for medical condition detection
Anthropic and Accenture are investing $2 billion in AI safety evaluation
summary: Indian markets recorded a sixth consecutive weekly decline amid global economic pressures. Traders in Ghaziabad announced a shift to cash-only transactions starting October 15 over UPI fees. Major AI investments and medical tech breakthroughs highlight the shifting global technology landscape.
